name: Uniper SE
summary: Uniper SE operates as an energy company in Germany, the United Kingdom, Sweden, the rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through Green Generation, Flexible Generation, and Greener Commodities segments. The Green Generation segment operates renewable and low carbon power generation facilities, including hydroelectric, nuclear, wind, and solar power plants. The Flexible Generation segment operates gas-fired power plants, such as combined-cycle gas turbine power plants, coal, and oiled-fired power plants; as well as the provision of energy services.
